disclaimer: Compiled from AISD, TEA, Texas Comptroller, Texas Tribune Schools Explorer, and contemporaneous reporting. Rounded figures are labeled. Always follow the source.

notes.recapture_2021_22_alt: AISD Recapture page lists FY2021-22 recapture as $765,741,768. Budget Process table lists $762,800,496. Both are shown on official AISD pages.
notes.recapture_2024_25_acfr: AISD 2025 ACFR reports $771.60 million in Chapter 49 / pass-through recapture expenses for the year ended June 30, 2025. The Budget Process table lists $777,158,149 for 2025.
notes.enrollment_tribune: Texas Tribune Schools Explorer (TEA data) reports 69,074 students in 2026, down 17.4% since 2016.
